```{r Load Libraries}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
```

```{r Q2.a Create Example Data Table}
## looked for similar tables to understand the question 
#https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamanetworkopen/fullarticle/2791533
#https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39504023/
#https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11541642/


set.seed(123)

# Define parameters
calendar_dates <- seq.Date(from = as.Date("2025-05-01"), to = as.Date("2025-05-21"), by = "day")
age_groups <- c("<18","18-39", "40-64", "65+")
sexes <- c("M", "F")
races <- c("White", "Black","Hispanic","Asian","Two or more reces", "Other")
clinics <- c("Clinic One", "Clinic Two")

# combination of strata and calendar days
data_table <- expand.grid(
  Calendar_Date = calendar_dates,
  Age_Group = age_groups,
  Sex = sexes,
  Race = races,
  Clinic = clinics,
  Risk_Window = c('1-21 days','22-42 days')
  #Risk_Type = c("risk", "comparison")
)

# Random person-days and outcome events
data_table <- data_table %>%
  mutate(
    Person_Days = sample(500:1000, n(), replace = TRUE),
    Outcome_Events = rpois(n(), lambda = ifelse(Risk_Window == '1-21 days', 2.5, 1.5))
  )

# View example rows
head(data_table)

df <- data_table # work on df, data_table stays as it is for any reference

```



```{r Q2.a plot to visualize the cumulative incidence of the targeted outcomes}

# Aggregate daily outcome events by interval type
daily_counts <- df %>%
  group_by(Calendar_Date, Risk_Window) %>%
  summarise(Outcome_Events = sum(Outcome_Events), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Calendar_Date)

# Calculate cumulative outcome counts over time
Cumulative_Incidence <- daily_counts %>%
  group_by(Risk_Window) %>%
  arrange(Calendar_Date) %>%
  mutate(Cumulative_Events = cumsum(Outcome_Events))

# Plot cumulative incidence
ggplot(Cumulative_Incidence, aes(x = Calendar_Date, y = Cumulative_Events, color = Risk_Window)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative Incidence of Outcome Events by Interval Type",
    pval = TRUE,
    x = "Calendar Date",
    y = "Cumulative Number of Events",
    color = "Interval Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```
```{r Q2.b Poison Model}
# Fitting Poison Model 
Pois_model <- glm(Outcome_Events ~ Risk_Window,offset = log(Person_Days),family = poisson(link = "log"),data = df)
summary(Pois_model)

# Extracting coefficient and compute Rate Ratio
coef_est <- coef(Pois_model)["Risk_Window22-42 days"]
rate_ratio <- exp(coef_est)

# Print result
cat("Rate Ratio (22–42 days vs 1–21 days):", round(rate_ratio, 2), "\n")
```


```{r Q2.c Add Required Columns for Conditional Logistic Regression}

# Creating binary outcome
df <- df %>%
  mutate(Outcome_Bin = ifelse(Outcome_Events > 0, 1, 0))

# Creating unique strata based on CDC matching criteria
df <- df %>%
  mutate(Stratum_ID = paste(Calendar_Date, Age_Group, Sex, Race, Clinic, sep = "_"))


df %>% select(Stratum_ID, Risk_Window, Outcome_Bin) %>% head()
```

```{r Q2.c Conditional Logistic Regression}

# Making sure Risk_Window is a factor
df$Risk_Window <- factor(df$Risk_Window, levels = c("1-21 days", "22-42 days"))

# Fitting the conditional logistic regression
clogit_model <- clogit(Outcome_Bin ~ Risk_Window + strata(Stratum_ID), data = df)

summary(clogit_model)

# Extracting coefficient and CI from clogit coxph model

summary_model <- summary(clogit_model)
coef_est <- summary_model$coefficients["Risk_Window22-42 days", "coef"]
or <- exp(coef_est)

# 95% CI
lower_ci <- summary_model$conf.int["Risk_Window22-42 days", "lower .95"]
upper_ci <- summary_model$conf.int["Risk_Window22-42 days", "upper .95"]

# Print
cat("Odds Ratio (22–42 vs 1–21 days):", round(or, 2),
    "[95% CI:", round(lower_ci, 2), "–", round(upper_ci, 2), "]\n")

```
